title: Bag of Tokens
description: Maximize your score by playing tokens face up (cost power) or face down (gain power).
pseudocode:
1. tokens.sort((a,b) => a-b)
2. while left <= right:
3.   if power >= tokens[left]: power -= tokens[left++], score++
4.   else if score > 0: power += tokens[right--], score--
5.   else: break

steps.note: Power 100 >= token 100. Spend power, gain score.
Score is now 1, power is 0. Move left pointer.
Power 0 < token 200. Score > 0, so trade score for power.
Power becomes 200, score becomes 0. Move right pointer.
